rationale: The assistant correctly framed pulsing as the V8's airflow/blockage protection, asked the right first questions (model, pulses without wand), and led the customer through emptying the bin, washing a never-cleaned filter with correct cold-water/24h-dry/no-direct-heat guidance, and clearing the wand, head and inlet, reaching the true fix with no part needed. Weaknesses: it repeatedly pushed a battery-fault alternative and a 'no-filter test' (Dyson does not recommend running without the filter, and the logic 'if it still pulses, airflow isn't the issue' wrongly ignores cyclone/inlet blockages), and the long multi-step lists repeated filter and battery content across several messages. All part talk was conditional and model-appropriate, so no critical failures; a UK homeowner would have been well served overall.
